operating_notes.text: Master Capital Services Limited listed 30,000 secured, redeemable, non-cumulative, taxable NCDs at an 11% coupon, maturing 05-Aug-2027.
FY26 consolidated revenue was ₹575.85 Cr, of which interest earned was ₹166.58 Cr.

timeline.summary: On 07-May-2026, NSE listed 30,000 11% NCDs (₹10,000 face value, maturing 05-Aug-2027) issued by wholly owned subsidiary Master Capital Services Limited on its debt segment.
Master Trust's wholly-owned subsidiary Master Capital Services commenced F&O clearing and settlement services on NSE and BSE on 15 October 2026
